name: Amazons (Lustria)
source: Town Cryer #15 (Grade 1b), Lustria setting. Text supplied directly by the owner on 2026-08-02; cross-check against your own copy. Racial maximums are not stated in this entry; the human maximum profile is used, matching the Mordheim-setting Amazon list.

specialRules.name: Leader
specialRules.description: Any models in the warband within 6" of the Priestess may use her Leadership instead of their own.

specialRules.name: Wizard
specialRules.description: The Priestess is a Wizard and may use Amazon Rituals. She starts with one ritual chosen at random from the list.

heroSlots.notes: Only Piranha Warriors may carry the Conch Shell Horn.

henchmenTypes.notes: A warband must include at least one Amazon Warrior.

specialRules.name: One with the Jungle
specialRules.description: A Jaguar has lived her life in the deepest parts of the jungle and can move through jungle terrain without penalty.

exclusiveEquipment.name: Starblade
exclusiveEquipment.rulesText:
Range: Close Combat; Strength: as user.

+1 enemy armour save: the enemy gets +1 to his armour save.

Potential parry: a Starblade can parry the first successful hit of any combat on a 4+.

exclusiveEquipment.name: Starsword
exclusiveEquipment.rulesText:
Range: Close Combat; Strength: as user +1.

Parry: can parry enemy blows.

Ignores armour: a Starsword ignores all armour saves except ward and dodge saves.

exclusiveEquipment.name: Sunstaff (Lustria)
exclusiveEquipment.rulesText:
Range: 12" / Close Combat; Strength: as user.

Sunbolt: in the shooting phase the wielder may discharge a beam of energy with a range of 12", hitting at Strength 4. Aside from ward and dodge saves, a Sunbolt ignores armour saves and penalties for long range.

exclusiveEquipment.name: Bolas
exclusiveEquipment.rulesText:
Range: 16"; Strength: special. Usable once per battle and automatically recovered afterwards.

Dangerous: if the roll to hit is a natural 1, the bolas brain the wielder for a Strength 3 hit.

Entangle: a model hit is not hurt, but his legs are entangled and he cannot move. He also suffers -2 Weapon Skill in hand-to-hand combat, though he may still shoot normally. He may try to free himself in the recovery phase, and is freed on a 4+.

exclusiveEquipment.name: Javelins
exclusiveEquipment.rulesText:
Range: 8"; Strength: as user.

Thrown weapon: the warrior suffers no penalty for range or for moving.

specialRules: Amazons (Lustria, Town Cryer #15). Isolationists: Amazons re-roll any attack rolls that miss in the first round of combat against Lizardmen and Norse. | Sacrifice: they follow the rules for the Possessed when it comes to captives; sacrificing a captured Lizardman also grants a free set of Enchanted Skins. | Norse Enmity: against a Norse warband, Amazons may re-roll their first failed Rout test, and may never voluntarily rout unless their leader has been taken out of action. | Not one of us: Amazons may not hire any Hired Swords or Dramatis Personae unless those are themselves Amazons. | Min warband size 3, max 15. Exactly one Serpent Priestess. At least one Amazon Warrior.
